rules: 只允许引用 allowed_evidence_ids 里的证据 id，禁止编造证据

不确定的判断写入 assumptions 并降低 confidence
输出必须是单个 JSON 对象，不要输出任何 JSON 之外的文字
只依据 inputs.text 中的真实文本判断，不得使用外部知识补全事实
带 vocab 的键取值必须严格从词表中选择；判断不了就进 missing_fields
multi 键可给列表；每个键必须带 evidence_refs 与 confidence

design_signals.text: ✦ Flattering Crew Neck & Cap Sleeve Design: This timeless maxi dress features a soft crew neck and cap sleeves that cover arms gently, with a flowing curved hem that skims your figure beautifully. Hugs in all the right places without feeling restrictive—ideal for everyday confidence. Cap Sleeve/ Crew Neck/ Maxi Dress/ Curved Hem/ Classic Fit/ Versatile Dress/ Solid Color/ Floral Print.|||✦ Ultra-Soft All-Day Comfort Fabric: Crafted from 95% Polyester + 5% Spandex blend, this dress feels silky smooth against skin—lightweight yet not sheer. Breathable for warm days and wrinkle-resistant, perfect for travel or busy schedules (no ironing needed!) .|||✦ Effortlessly Versatile for Every Occasion: Dress down with sneakers for grocery runs, layer with a blazer for office meetings, or add a belt and heels for dinner dates. Works for brunch, church, family gatherings, vacation, or casual home days—truly a wardrobe staple .|||✦ Fits All Body Types Perfectly: Sizes S(US 4-6), M(US 8-10), L(US 12-14), XL(US 16-18), XXL(US 20-22). True-to-size fit that flatters curves and offers room to move—choose your regular size for a comfortable, polished look .|||✦ Easy Care & Long-Lasting Quality: Machine washable (cold water) and tumble dry low—colors stay vibrant wash after wash. No dry cleaning needed, saving you time and money. Available in neutral solids and subtle florals you’ll reach for again and again .
